_about: Public-domain Robert Easton, Presbyterian minister in Montreal, for the Word Hoard: Reasons for Joy and Praise (1815), a sermon before the Female Benevolent Society of Montreal, and a sermon on the imperfection of the present state. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 127 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

easton-joy-and-praise: Reasons for joy and praise : a sermon preached April 6, 1815 : being the day of general thanksgiving for peace with the United States : in the Presbyterian Church, St. Peter's Street, Montreal (Montreal : Printed by Nahum Mower, 1815)
easton-female-benevolent: A sermon, delivered before the members of the Female Benevolent Society, in Montreal, September 8, 1816 (Montreal : Printed by Nahum Mower, 1816)
easton-imperfection: A sermon on the imperfection of the present state (Montreal : Printed by Nahum Mower, 1820)

_excluded.easton-others: the description of pictures (1752), the chemistry papers and the division-courts letter are by other men
